title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites.
